label: TP
reason: User-provided parameter name is extracted via getParameterNames() and used as the param variable in the loop, then passed to doSomething(), which assigns it to bar if the guard condition is met. The guard expression (500/42) + num > 200 evaluates to 196+196=392 > 200, which is always true, so the user input directly reaches the SQL sink without being sanitized or encoded.

evidence.note: Param from request is assigned to bar via doSomething and injected into SQL query
